name: Logo wall
what: Real logos of the logo library: your stack, the platforms you post on, the tools a video is about or the clients you worked with - a grid of app tiles popping in one after another, an endless sliding strip, or one big logo at a time, each replacing the last, with the names under them.
origin: Videos about tools and apps keep naming them ("I edit in Premiere, grade in Resolve", "follow me on TikTok and YouTube", "the AI tools I use") - the logo library made real logos possible (2026-10-16); template sites list logo grids and logo marquees among their most used
motion: grid: a tile every 6 f, back.out 12 f from 0.2, the logo 3 f later, the name 6 f later, then a slow breathe; marquee: a steady slide the whole length (5 px a frame at 1080), lanes the other way; spotlight: the length shared out, each logo back.out 12 f with a ring going out over 18 f, the last one breathes
